City of Ottawa Building Code Services
Screen whether your deck, shed or renovation needs a building permit.

Many home projects need a building permit before work starts. In Ontario, a deck more than 60 centimetres above the ground needs a permit, and so does a shed larger than 15 square metres. Moving walls, adding plumbing or finishing a basement also need one. Painting, flooring and new cabinets usually don't. Zoning rules, like setbacks from your property line, apply even when no permit is needed.
